title: 'susi tasks next' picks and claims the best unclaimed task
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Choose by priority, dependencies, size and the agent's lane, then claim it atomically, so an agent needs no decision. Tests zc_tasks_next_*.
